items.title: A sheaf of sets injects into the product of its stalks over an open set
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file sheaves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: 8 行、层到茎的茎映射单射：逐点同茎给出邻域 V^x 上相等；这些邻域覆盖 U；由层条件的唯一性得 s = s'。承重两步（germ 展开、层唯一性）都在 span 内；无外部引用。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-sheaf-subset-stalks (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1162-1172

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: if two sections have the same image in every stalk, then around each point they agree on some open neighbourhood, and these neighbourhoods cover the open set, so the sheaf uniqueness forces the sections to be equal (source lines 1174-1181)
